descriptionByLocale.it:
Mansioni

Il Senior Digital Acquisition Manager sarà responsabile della guida della strategia di marketing digitale su tutti i mercati MSC Cruises, con l'obiettivo di guidare le vendite dirette attraverso leve di pubblicità digitale, impostare e raggiungere gli obiettivi KPI e sviluppare campagne digitali innovative su più canali. Il candidato ideale avrà una solida esperienza nella pubblicità di prestazioni e nello sviluppo delle vendite digitali con un ROAS positivo, oltre a una forte esperienza nella strategia delle campagne di pubblicità digitale, nella pianificazione e implementazione dei media a pagamento e nella leadership del team. Inoltre, il ruolo comprenderà lo sviluppo di programmi di affiliazione e partnership come parte di una strategia di impegno digitale integrata per ampliare la portata, guidare il traffico qualificato e supportare il valore a lungo termine del cliente.

Il Tuo Impatto

- Sviluppare e mantenere relazioni solide con gli stakeholder di MSC in vari mercati, con una profonda comprensione delle loro esigenze aziendali, sfide e opportunità, bilanciando gli obiettivi globali stabiliti dalla sede centrale.
- Impostare e raggiungere gli obiettivi KPI per le vendite online attraverso leve di pubblicità digitale, assicurando che l'agenzia media consegni contro i target e gli obblighi contrattuali.
- Guidare le riunioni interne, le QBR e le revisioni annuali fornendo insight strategici e raccomandazioni basati sulle prestazioni della campagna, sulle analisi del sito web, sulle tendenze di mercato e sul panorama competitivo.
- Pianificare e implementare campagne di marketing delle prestazioni innovative su canali Paid Search, Display, Social, Native, Digital Audio e Video, personalizzate per gli obiettivi aziendali e le dinamiche di mercato.
- Collaborare con i team interni, tra cui Creativo, Social Media, Data & Analytics, SEO, Content, Product e gli agency partner, per garantire la consegna tempestiva di asset di alta qualità allineati con gli obiettivi di vendita digitale annuali.
- Identificare e inseguire opportunità per migliorare i flussi di entrate attraverso strategie digitali esistenti e nuove, migliorando il ROAS della campagna e sperimentando innovazioni nell'ecosistema adtech e martech.
- Sviluppare e gestire strategie di generazione di lead, assicurando che i flussi di acquisizione del cliente e le tattiche di nurturing siano in atto su tutti i punti di contatto dei media a pagamento.
- Monitorare il resourcing del conto e la redditività per garantire che i mercati locali e la sede centrale siano gestiti in modo efficiente e redditizio.
- Fare da punto di escalation principale per le preoccupazioni sollevate dai team interni o dagli stakeholder dei mercati locali.
- Continuare a rivedere e ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro operativi, proponendo e implementando miglioramenti dei processi dove rilevante.
- Collaborare con gli stakeholder dei paesi e della sede centrale per preparare e gestire il budget di marketing digitale annuale, allineato con gli obiettivi di fatturato B2C di MSC Cruises.
- Guidare e ottimizzare i programmi di affiliazione e partnership per guidare il traffico qualificato e le conversazioni, assicurando l'allineamento con la strategia di acquisizione digitale e gli obiettivi di prestazione.
- Gestire i partner chiave e le iniziative co-branded, coordinandosi con i team interni per garantire l'esecuzione e il tracciamento senza soluzione di continuità.

Il Tuo Percorso Finora

- 7+ anni di esperienza in un ruolo simile.
- Esperienza pratica con gli strumenti di analisi e ad server come GA4, Adobe Analytics, Campaign Manager e i loro framework di reporting pertinenti.
- Provenienza nell'gestire, mentorare e aggiornare i membri del team.
- Passata esperienza nella strategia e nell'esecuzione della generazione di lead è un forte plus.
- Solida esperienza nella proprietà del budget e nel controllo dei costi.

I Tuoi Elementi Essenziali

- Fluente in inglese (ulteriori lingue sono un plus).
- Solide competenze analitiche e la capacità di utilizzare i dati per prendere decisioni informate.
- Provenienza nel guidare la crescita delle vendite dirette e migliorare il ROAS attraverso campagne pubblicitarie digitali ad alte prestazioni.
- Passione per il marketing digitale, i media di prestazione e le soluzioni digitali innovative.
- Profonda conoscenza delle piattaforme pubblicitarie di Google e Meta, comprese l'auditing della configurazione, l'implementazione e l'analisi delle prestazioni con insight azionabili.
- Eccellenti competenze organizzative, di gestione dei progetti e di risoluzione dei problemi.
- Proficiente in Microsoft Office e negli strumenti di visualizzazione dei dati come Datorama.
- Solide competenze di collaborazione e comunicazione, con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente con i team interni e i partner esterni.
- Capacità di identificare le tendenze nei dati e trasformare gli insight in raccomandazioni strategiche azionabili.
- Autostarter con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e prendere l'iniziativa.
- Comunicatore sicuro di sé e articolato, a proprio agio nell'interagire con i senior stakeholder e i team interni.
- Forte capacità di pensiero strategico, in grado di agire come un 'Consigliere Fedele' per la direzione senior.
- Alta attenzione ai dettagli e la capacità di gestire le priorità multiple in un ambiente dinamico e veloce.
- Atteggiamento positivo, mentalità proattiva e la spinta ad abbracciare le nuove sfide.
- Conoscenza delle piattaforme di affiliazione come Awin, Kwanko e strumenti simili. Forte rete di contatti dell'industria per avviare opportunità di partnership e collaborazioni del marchio.

Il Nostro Impegno

Siamo impegnati a costruire un futuro che valorizza le prospettive diverse, accoglie il mondo oltre i confini e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e empowerment per essere se stesso. Il nostro impegno si estende all'assunzione di azioni misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronta/o a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a MSC Cruises, dove le nuove opportunità ti aspettano. Candidati oggi per far parte di un team globale che spinge i limiti e raggiunge risultati eccezionali. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

Shipments

The Senior Digital Acquisition Manager will be responsible for guiding the digital marketing strategy on all MSC Cruises markets, with the aim to drive direct sales through digital advertising levers, set up and achieve KPI goals and develop innovative digital campaigns on multiple channels. The ideal candidate will have a solid experience in advertising performance and developing digital sales with a positive ROAS, as well as a strong experience in the strategy of digital advertising campaigns, planning and implementation of paid media and team leadership. In addition, the role will include the development of affiliate programs and partnerships as part of an integrated digital commitment strategy to expand the scope, drive qualified traffic and support the long-term value of the customer.

Your Impact

- Develop and maintain solid relations with MSC stakeholders in various markets, with a deep understanding of their business needs, challenges and opportunities, balancing the global goals established by the headquarters.
- Set and achieve the KPI targets for online sales through digital advertising levers, ensuring that the media agency delivers against targets and contractual obligations.
- Guide internal meetings, QBRs and annual revisions by providing strategic insights and recommendations based on campaign performance, website analysis, market trends and competitive landscape.
- Plan and implement innovative performance marketing campaigns on Paid Search, Display, Social, Native, Digital Audio and Video channels, tailored for business objectives and market dynamics.
- Collaboration with the internal teams, including Creative, Social Media, Data & Analytics, SEO, Content, Product and agency partners, to ensure timely delivery of high quality assets aligned with annual digital sales goals.
- Identify and pursue opportunities to improve revenue flows through existing and new digital strategies, improving the ROAS of the campaign and experiencing innovations in the adtech and martech ecosystem.
- Develop and manage lead generation strategies, ensuring that customer acquisition flows and nurturing tactics are in place on all paid media contact points.
- Monitor account resourcing and profitability to ensure that local markets and headquarters are managed efficiently and profitable.
- Main escalation point for concerns raised by internal teams or local market stakeholders.
- Continue to review and optimize operational workflows, proposing and implementing process improvements where relevant.
- Collaboration with the stakeholders of the countries and headquarters to prepare and manage the annual digital marketing budget, aligned with the B2C turnover objectives of MSC Cruises.
- Drive and optimize affiliate programs and partnerships to drive qualified traffic and conversations, ensuring alignment with digital acquisition strategy and performance goals.
- Manage key partners and co-branded initiatives, coordinating with internal teams to ensure seamless execution and tracking.

Your Path

- 7+ years of experience in a similar role.
- Practical experience with analytics and server tools such as GA4, Adobe Analytics, Campaign Manager and their relevant reporting frameworks.
- Provenience to manage, mentor and update team members.
- Past experience in the strategy and execution of the lead generation is a strong plus.
- Solid experience in budget ownership and cost control.

Your Essential Elements

- English fluent (last languages are a plus).
- Solid analytical skills and the ability to use data to make informed decisions.
- Provenience to drive direct sales growth and improve ROAS through high-performance digital advertising campaigns.
- Passion for digital marketing, performance media and innovative digital solutions.
- Deep knowledge of Google and Meta advertising platforms, including configuration auditing, implementation and performance analysis with actionable insights.
- Excellent organizational skills, project management and troubleshooting.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office and data display tools such as Datorama.
- Solid collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal teams and external partners.
- Ability to identify trends in data and transform insights into operational strategic recommendations.
- Autostarter with the ability to work independently and take the initiative.
- Safe communication of self and articulated, at ease in interacting with senior stakeholders and internal teams.
- Strong strategic thinking ability, able to act as a 'Loyal Council' for senior management.
- High attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and fast environment.
- Positive attitude, proactive mentality and the drive to embrace new challenges.
- Knowledge of affiliate platforms such as Awin, Kwanko and similar tools. Strong network of industry contacts to start opportunities for partnerships and partnerships of the brand.

Our Commitment

We are committed to building a future that enhances different perspectives, welcomes the world beyond borders and promotes an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be himself. Our commitment extends to taking measures that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await you. Apply today to be part of a global team that pushes limits and achieves exceptional results. Your journey begins here!

Expéditions

Le Senior Digital Acquisition Manager sera chargé de guider la stratégie de marketing numérique sur tous les marchés MSC Cruises, dans le but de stimuler les ventes directes à travers des leviers publicitaires numériques, de mettre en place et d'atteindre les objectifs KPI et de développer des campagnes numériques innovantes sur plusieurs canaux. Le candidat idéal aura une solide expérience dans la performance publicitaire et le développement de ventes numériques avec un ROAS positif, ainsi qu'une solide expérience dans la stratégie de campagnes publicitaires numériques, la planification et la mise en œuvre des médias payants et le leadership d'équipe. De plus, le rôle comprendra l'élaboration de programmes d'affiliation et de partenariats dans le cadre d'une stratégie intégrée d'engagement numérique visant à élargir la portée, à stimuler le trafic qualifié et à soutenir la valeur à long terme du client.

Votre impact

- Établir et maintenir des relations solides avec les intervenants du SMC sur divers marchés, en comprenant parfaitement leurs besoins, leurs défis et leurs possibilités, en conciliant les objectifs mondiaux établis par le siège.
- Définir et atteindre les objectifs de KPI pour les ventes en ligne par le biais de leviers publicitaires numériques, en veillant à ce que l'agence de presse respecte les objectifs et les obligations contractuelles.
- Guider les réunions internes, les RQQ et les révisions annuelles en fournissant des idées stratégiques et des recommandations fondées sur la performance de la campagne, l'analyse du site Web, les tendances du marché et le paysage concurrentiel.
- Planifier et mettre en œuvre des campagnes de marketing de performance innovantes sur les canaux payants de recherche, d'affichage, social, autochtone, audio numérique et vidéo, adaptées aux objectifs commerciaux et à la dynamique du marché.
- Collaboration avec les équipes internes, y compris Creative, Social Media, Data & Analytics, SEO, Content, Product et agences partenaires, afin d'assurer la livraison en temps opportun d'actifs de haute qualité alignés sur les objectifs annuels de ventes numériques.
- Identifier et rechercher des possibilités d'améliorer les flux de revenus grâce aux stratégies numériques existantes et nouvelles, d'améliorer le ROAS de la campagne et d'expérimenter des innovations dans l'écosystème adtech et martech.
- Élaborer et gérer des stratégies de production de plomb, en veillant à ce que les flux d'acquisition des clients et les tactiques d'encouragement soient en place sur tous les points de contact des médias payants.
- Surveiller les ressources et la rentabilité des comptes afin de s'assurer que les marchés locaux et le siège sont gérés de manière efficace et rentable.
- Principal point d'escalade des préoccupations soulevées par les équipes internes ou les acteurs du marché local.
- Continuer d'examiner et d'optimiser les flux de travail opérationnels, en proposant et en mettant en œuvre des améliorations de processus le cas échéant.
- Collaboration avec les parties prenantes des pays et du siège pour préparer et gérer le budget annuel de marketing numérique, aligné sur les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires B2C de MSC Cruises.
- Conduire et optimiser les programmes d'affiliation et les partenariats pour stimuler le trafic qualifié et les conversations, en assurant l'alignement avec la stratégie d'acquisition numérique et les objectifs de performance.
- Gérer les principaux partenaires et les initiatives co-marquées, en coordination avec les équipes internes afin d'assurer une exécution et un suivi transparents.

Votre chemin

- 7 ans et plus d'expérience dans un rôle similaire.
- Expérience pratique avec les outils d'analyse et de serveur tels que GA4, Adobe Analytics, Campaign Manager et leurs cadres de rapport pertinents.
- Possibilité de gérer, de guider et de mettre à jour les membres de l'équipe.
- L'expérience passée dans la stratégie et l'exécution de la génération de plomb est un plus fort.
- Une solide expérience en matière de propriété budgétaire et de contrôle des coûts.

Vos éléments essentiels

- Anglais couramment (les dernières langues sont un plus).
- Des compétences analytiques solides et la capacité d'utiliser les données pour prendre des décisions éclairées.
- La possibilité de stimuler la croissance des ventes directes et d'améliorer le ROAS grâce à des campagnes publicitaires numériques de haute performance.
- Passion pour le marketing numérique, les médias de performance et les solutions numériques innovantes.
- Une connaissance approfondie des plateformes publicitaires Google et Meta, y compris l'audit de configuration, la mise en œuvre et l'analyse de performance avec des informations pratiques.
- Excellentes compétences organisationnelles, gestion de projet et dépannage.
- Compétence en Microsoft Office et outils d'affichage de données tels que Datorama.
- Des compétences solides en collaboration et en communication, avec la capacité de travailler efficacement avec des équipes internes et des partenaires externes.
- Capacité d'identifier les tendances dans les données et de transformer les idées en recommandations stratégiques opérationnelles.
- Autostarter avec la capacité de travailler indépendamment et prendre l'initiative.
- Communication sûre de soi et articulée, à l'aise dans l'interaction avec les principaux intervenants et les équipes internes.
- Forte capacité de réflexion stratégique, capable d'agir comme un « conseil de liaison » pour la haute direction.
- Une grande attention au détail et la capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement dynamique et rapide.
- attitude positive, mentalité proactive et volonté de relever de nouveaux défis.
- Connaissance des plateformes d'affiliation comme Awin, Kwanko et des outils similaires. Un solide réseau de contacts avec l'industrie pour créer des possibilités de partenariat et de partenariat de la marque.

Notre engagement

Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui renforce différentes perspectives, accueille le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être lui-même. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

We are seeking a high-caliber, dedicated PMO Lead / Senior Project Manager to oversee a strategic infrastructure investment project in the Caribbean, while establishing governance and execution discipline across current and future projects in the investment pipeline.
This role carries full accountability for project delivery, spanning finance, construction, commercial, operational, HR, regulatory, and stakeholder dimensions. The successful candidate will act as the single point of coordination and control between investors, contractors, operators, lenders, and government stakeholders.

Your Impact

• Establish and lead a Project Management System, including governance, reporting, controls, and KPIs.
• Drive end-to-end execution of major infrastructure projects, from development through construction and into operations.
• Oversees construction delivery and project financials, including budgets, cash flow, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, lender requirements, and reporting.
• Lead commercial and contract management, supplier, and concession PPP agreements.
• Ensure operational readiness and handover, including systems, staffing, and procedures.
• Coordinate HR and workforce planning, ensuring compliance with local labor laws and effective contractor management.
• Identify and manage project risks across technical, financial, regulatory, ESG, and political dimensions.
• Provide PMO oversight and execution support for additional projects in the development funnel.

Your Journey so far

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Business, or related field; Master’s degree preferred.
• 15+ years of experience in large-scale infrastructure or real asset projects.
• Demonstrated leadership of complex, capital-intensive projects with multiple stakeholders.
• Strong experience across construction, project finance, commercial contracts, and operations.
• Experience in emerging markets and/or the Caribbean region strongly preferred.
• PMP / PRINCE2 or equivalent certification preferred.

Your Essentials

• Hands-on, structured, and highly accountable
• Executive presence and credibility with senior stakeholders
• Comfortable working in complex, multi-jurisdictional environments
• Willing to travel and be on-site as required

descriptionByLocale.fr: Votre but Nous recherchons un spécialiste des produits Mobile App dynamique et très motivé pour rejoindre notre équipe Business Innovation au siège de MSC Cruises à Genève. Ce rôle est conçu pour un professionnel axé sur les données et doté d'un sens commercial fort, d'un état d'esprit analytique et d'une passion pour l'optimisation des parcours des utilisateurs mobiles. Le candidat retenu explorera les comportements dans l'application, éliminera les frictions dans l'entonnoir de vente, et animera des initiatives axées sur les produits afin de maximiser les taux de conversion et de façonner l'avenir des expériences d'invités numériques dans l'écosystème numérique du SMC pour moi. Votre impact - Analyser le parcours utilisateur et le comportement de MSC for Me pour identifier les goulets d'étranglement, proposer et valider des initiatives de produits qui optimisent l'entonnoir de vente et boostent les taux de conversion dans l'application. - Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles de produit, de technologie et d'UX/UI pour concevoir et mettre en œuvre des caractéristiques qui favorisent l'acquisition organique par les utilisateurs et augmentent les possibilités de vente croisée/up-seller pour l'écosystème numérique du SMC pour moi. - Mettre en oeuvre et optimiser la position d'application des offres commerciales (travaillant à la fermeture avec le service commercial de Revenus embarqués) pour maximiser la visibilité et les conversions de ventes spécifiquement pour les utilisateurs mobiles. - Utiliser des outils avancés d'analyse de produits et de visualisation des données (Power BI) pour suivre les performances de vente, les taux d'activation des utilisateurs et les retombées dans l'écosystème numérique MSC for Me. - Agir comme un pont entre le service commercial des revenus à bord et les équipes de tech/développement, transformant les objectifs de revenus en exigences de produits numériques claires pour améliorer l'écosystème numérique du SMC pour moi. - Conduire l'acquisition de MSC pour moi par canal en raffinant les fonctionnalités de l'application native – comme les flux d'utilisateurs invités à enregistrer sans friction, les mécanismes d'invitation à un ami et le partage d'applications sans faille – pour accroître la base d'utilisateurs. - Effectuer des tests A/B sur les flux de ventes, les processus de paiement et les modèles d'abonnement de MSC for Me afin d'améliorer continuellement l'efficacité opérationnelle et la production de revenus. Votre voyage jusqu'à présent - Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en administration des affaires, économie, gestion du marketing, numérique ou un domaine connexe. - Fortes compétences commerciales et analytiques avec 3 à 5 ans d'expérience prouvée dans les ventes numériques, la croissance de produits ou le développement d'entreprises numériques, avec un accent strict sur les applications mobiles. - Expérience pratique de l'analyse des applications, de l'optimisation des taux de conversion (CRO) et des outils de manipulation/visualisation des données (Power BI, SQL; Python est un plus). - Familiarité avec les méthodologies agiles et capacité de travailler côte à côte avec les développeurs et les gestionnaires de produits dans des environnements dynamiques et rapides. - Excellentes compétences en communication et en collaboration, avec la capacité de traduire les connaissances basées sur les données en recommandations pratiques pour les entreprises et les produits. - Un penseur créatif avec une approche proactive de la résolution de problèmes, capable de stimuler la "croissance axée sur les produits" plutôt que de compter sur les dépenses de marketing traditionnelles. - Fluent en anglais; les langues européennes supplémentaires sont un plus. Vos essentiels - Compréhension approfondie du comportement des utilisateurs mobiles, des entonnoirs de vente numériques et des écosystèmes d'acquisition axés sur les produits. - Forte entreprise avec un accent sur la maximisation de la valeur de vie du client (CLV) et l'élimination des frictions de l'expérience d'achat mobile. - Capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités et de produire des produits de haute qualité dans des délais serrés. titleByLocale.fr: Stagiaire en développement portuaire junior Architecte

descriptionByLocale.it: Il tuo scopo Il Junior Architect supporta il team Port Development attraverso una produzione veloce e accurata di disegni concettuali e tecnici. Il ruolo è focalizzato sull'esecuzione interna: trasformare gli input di progettazione in documentazione concettuale e visualizzazioni efficaci per supportare il processo decisionale in destinazioni private, terminal crociere, infrastrutture portuali e strutture correlate. Il tuo impatto - Sostenere la traduzione di input di business e design in studi di zoning, diagrammi spaziali di base e layout architettonici. - Assistere nello sviluppo di layout preliminari a seguito di indicazioni di progettazione interna e requisiti operativi. - Preparare pacchetti di progettazione concettuale di fase iniziale per la revisione interna e il coordinamento. - Produrre ponti di presentazione, diagrammi, narrazioni visive e schede materiali per supportare la comunicazione interna. - Sviluppare modelli 3D obbligatori e visualizzazioni in tempo reale per supportare recensioni interne e presentazioni a livello executive. - Aggiornare rapidamente, correggere e rivedere i disegni architettonici, inclusi piani, sezioni, elevazioni, layout, studi di facciata e diagrammi di circolazione. - Adapt e coordinare la porta e disegni civili, tra cui layout del sito, interfacce infrastrutturali, strade di circolazione e coordinamento del paesaggio duro. Il tuo viaggio finora - Forte passione per l'architettura e il mondo degli interni, dei materiali e della composizione spaziale. - Curioso e orientato al design, con attenzione alla proporzione, atmosfera e dettaglio. - Esecuzione guidata e altamente operativa. - Veloce nella produzione di disegno e revisioni. - Dettaglio e strutturato. - Confortevole lavoro sotto tempi stringenti in un ambiente di sviluppo dinamico. I tuoi essenziali - Proficienza avanzata in AutoCAD con forte velocità di redazione e precisione. - Forte capacità di modellazione 3D in SketchUp o Revit (preferito SketchUp). - Esperienza obbligatoria con strumenti di rendering in tempo reale (Enscape, Twinmotion o equivalente). - Buona conoscenza di Photoshop per post-produzione e correzioni. - Conoscenza di base di strumenti AI (o di interesse) come Diffusione Stabile o AI Magnifico. - La capacità di produrre in modo indipendente le visualizzazioni chiare e standard per il processo decisionale interno. - Portfolio che include disegni tecnici e visualizzazioni rese da condividere con il CV. Il Junior Architect Port Development Intern deve essere iscritto in un programma di studio che richiede un valido accordo di stage. I candidati devono avere un passaporto UE o avere il diritto legale di lavorare in Svizzera. È richiesta una completa competenza professionale in inglese; le lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio. Il nostro impegno Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta. Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!
descriptionByLocale.en: Your Purpose The Junior Architect supports the Port Development team through fast and accurate production of conceptual and technical drawings. The role is focused on internal execution: transforming design inputs into conceptual documentation and effective visualizations to support decision-making across private destinations, cruise terminals, port infrastructure and related facilities. Your Impact - Support the translation of business and design inputs into zoning studies, basic spatial diagrams, and architectural layouts. - Assist in the development of preliminary layouts following internal design guidance and operational requirements. - Prepare early stage conceptual design packages for internal review and coordination. - Produce presentation decks, diagrams, visual narratives, and material boards to support internal communication. - Develop mandatory 3D models and real time visualizations to support internal reviews and executive level presentations. - Rapidly update, correct, and revise architectural drawings, including plans, sections, elevations, layouts, façade studies, and circulation diagrams. - Adapt and coordinate port and civil drawings, including site layouts, infrastructure interfaces, circulation roads, and hardscape coordination. Your Journey so far - Strong passion for architecture and the world of interiors, materials and spatial composition. - Curious and design-oriented, with attention to proportion, atmosphere and detail. - Execution-driven and highly operational. - Fast in drawing production and revisions. - Detail-oriented and structured. - Comfortable working under tight timelines in a dynamic development environment. Your Essentials - Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD with strong drafting speed and precision. - Strong 3D modeling capabilities in SketchUp or Revit (SketchUp preferred). - Mandatory experience with real-time rendering tools (Enscape, Twinmotion or equivalent). - Good knowledge of Photoshop for post-production and corrections. - Basic knowledge of (or interest in) AI tools such as Stable Diffusion or Magnific AI. - The ability to independently produce clear, standard-quality visualizations for internal decision-making. - Portfolio including technical drawings and rendered visualizations to be shared with the CV. The Junior Architect Port Development Intern must be enrolled in a study program requiring a valid internship agreement. Candidates must hold an EU passport or have the legal right to work in Switzerland. Full professional proficiency in English is required; additional languages are an advantage. descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose Working at the heart of the business and in close partnership with the Corporate HR team, the Senior HR Business Partner provides strategic and hands-on HR support to assigned corporate functions and offices worldwide, within a fast-paced, service-driven hospitality environment. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

Do you excel at turning complexity into clarity? Are you energized by shaping ideas, challenging assumptions, and amplifying a leader’s impact?
We are seeking a New Builds Development & Delivery Manager who will act as an extension of the Senior Manager of Concept Innovation, enhancing strategic thinking, improving decision‑making speed, and helping bring robust, high-quality concepts to senior leadership.
This role is not operational and not a presentation-updating position. It is a partnership role, designed for someone who can think critically, structure ambiguous problems, challenge insights, and support the development of transformational guest experience concepts.You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across Experience, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, and Strategy, ensuring concepts are analytically sound, insight-driven, and aligned with the company expectations. You’ll gain exposure to strategic discussions, influence senior decision-making, and drive clarity across innovation workstreams.
If you are a sharp thinker, a natural challenger, and a trusted partner able to elevate the work of others, this is the role for you

Your Impact

Strategic Support & Thought Partnership

- Act as a direct strategic partner to the Senior Manager, helping structure thinking, frame problems, and sharpen concept narratives.

- Participate in or lead selected meetings on behalf of Guest Experience Innovation

- Prepare strategic briefs, decision frameworks, and synthesis documents for SVP-level conversations.

Narrative Building & Executive-Ready Communication

- Craft clear, concise, and strategically sound storytelling materials for leadership forums

- Transform complex information into high-impact narratives.

- Support leadership in preparing for SVP/EVP/Executive Committee discussions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Engage with Experience, Entertainment, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, Strategy, and Operations teams to gather insights and shape concepts.

- Lead the development and delivery of new entertainment concepts, experiences, and spaces across our fleet.

- Act as the key link between creative partners, operations, and corporate functions, ensuring alignment and buy-in at every stage.

Project & Stakeholder Management

- Drive clarity in workstreams by structuring timelines, identifying decision points, and anticipating risks.

- Follow up with stakeholders to ensure progress and alignment.

- Elevate issues early and propose mitigation scenarios.

Your Journey so far

- 5–8 years in strategy, innovation, business design, consulting, or strategic project management.

- Experience in hospitality, cruise, retail, consumer goods, or guest experience is a strong plus.

- Strong background in designing and executing guest-focused experiences, from concept to delivery.

- A balance of creativity and operational know-how, able to dream big and deliver practically.

- Proven track record in managing complex, cross-functional teams (operations, creative, marketing, sales, revenue, communications), with the ability to unite diverse perspectives around a single vision.

- Excellent knowledge of modern visual communication tools (Canva, Adobe Suite, AI-driven creative platforms) to produce compelling visual documents and storytelling assets beyond traditional slide decks.

- Excellent relationship-building skills; able to inspire, influence, and connect across diverse teams.

- Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with confidence at the executive level.

- Ability to travel 20-30% of the time.

- Fluent English; additional languages a plus.

Your Essentials

- Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

- EU Passport or right to work in Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

The Finance and Accounting Manager – New Investments will lead financial oversight, accounting, and performance management for the company’s new Strategic Value Chain Investments (“SVCI”). This role plays a critical part in ensuring strong financial controls, and partnering with cross-functional teams to optimize profitability across non-core cruise operations.
The ideal candidate brings a blend of technical accounting expertise, commercial finance acumen, and experience supporting investment-driven or multi-business environments.

Your Impact

Financial Management & Reporting

- Oversee accounting, month-end close, and financial reporting for SVCI

- Ensure accurate revenue recognition, cost allocation, and margin analysis for SVCI

- Prepare and review management reports, KPIs, and variance analyses to support business decisions

- Maintain compliance with internal controls, accounting standards, and company policies

New Investments & Business Evaluation

- Track post-investment performance versus plan and identify risks and improvement opportunities

Budgeting & Forecasting

- Assist the investments and the group during budgeting and rolling forecast processes

- Partner with operational leaders to develop realistic assumptions and financial targets

- Monitor performance against budgets and provide actionable insights

Cross-Functional Support

- Act as a finance business partner to support potential synergies within the investments.

- Collaborate with Legal, Treasury, Operations, and Commercial teams on contract structures, pricing models, and financial implications

- Support strategic initiatives related to expansion, innovation, and optimization of new investments

Process Improvement & Systems

- Improve financial processes, reporting automation, and data quality across investment activities

- Support implementation or enhancement of ERP, reporting tools, or financial systems as needed

- Identify opportunities to scale finance processes as new businesses grow

Your Journey so far

- Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field (CPA, ACA, ACCA, or equivalent strongly preferred) with a Big 4 background

- 6–10 years of progressive experience in finance and accounting, including exposure to investments, or multi-entity environments

- Experience in hospitality, travel, cruise, retail, consumer services, or asset-heavy industries is a strong plus

- Solid understanding of financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting

- Strong knowledge of IFRS accounting principles and financial controls

- Fluent in English, French and/or Italian are a plus

Your Essentials

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a commercial mindset

- Ability to translate financial data into clear insights for non-finance stakeholders

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with multiple stakeholders

- High attention to detail with the ability to see the big picture

- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills

Your Purpose

Join MSC Cruises for an exciting internship focused on analytics, performance tracking, and insight generation across two strategic areas: Customer Journey and Our best Programme.

This role is ideal for someone passionate about data analysis, insights generation, and dashboard creation, with a strong interest in improving employee and guest experience through measurable impact.

You will support the development of structured analysis, and follow‑up mechanisms, working closely with Customer Journey and HR department. The role provides hands‑on exposure to both guest‑focused and employee‑focused analytics.

Your Impact

Customer journey:

- Support recurring Customer Journey analyses, including canvas‑based reviews, mid‑season ship‑by‑ship analyses, and committee deliverables.

- Contribute to ad‑hoc deep‑dive analyses on specific topics, guest segments, nationalities, or ships, based on business and management requests.

- Prepare data extractions, charts, tables, and first‑level analytical outputs using standardised templates.

- Maintain Customer Journey analysis trackers, ensuring proper documentation, version control, and monitoring of action plans.

- Support follow‑up analyses and updates after pilots, operational changes, or management feedback.

- Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and alignment across Customer Journey deliverables and reporting.

Our BEST programme:

- Support the development, maintenance, and tracking of KPI frameworks for the OUR BEST programme.

- Consolidate and analyse data from multiple sources, including employee engagement surveys, OUR BEST feedback, training NPS, and relevant guest indicators.

- Build, update, and maintain dashboards to monitor programme performance, engagement, and impact over time.

- Produce regular performance reports and structured executive summaries for leadership reviews.

- Ensure data consistency, accuracy, and reporting standards across all OUR BEST analytics outputs.

- Support the preparation of data visualisations and storytelling materials for senior stakeholders.

Your Journey so far

- Degree (or currently enrolled) in Business, Data Analytics, Hospitality, or a related field

- Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail

- Advanced Excel skills; knowledge of dashboarding tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) is a plus

- Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate data into structured insights

- Fluent in English

descriptionByLocale.en:
Where passion meets opportunity Discover your journey into the extraordinary. Your Purpose Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers. The CRM Director – Insights, Customer Lifecycle & Marketing Automation leads the strategy and activation of data-driven customer engagement programs to inform the business and support commercial growth, loyalty and lifetime value. The role acts as business lead for lifecycle marketing and marketing automation, working in close partnership with Commercial, Digital, IT, Data and Legal teams to ensure scalable, compliant and high-performing customer communications. He/ She leads the customer’s insights area recommending how to approach the brand evolution assessment. The role is based in Geneva, Switzerland. Your Impact 1. Lifecycle Strategy & Co-Ownership
• Lead the definition of the global customer lifecycle strategy organizing the customer journey vision with Commercial, Digital and Guest Experience teams.
• Translate lifecycle ambition into structured activation roadmaps across owned marketing automation channels.
• Define lifecycle design principles, segmentation logic and engagement frameworks aligned with brand and commercial objectives.
• Ensure cross-functional alignment between customer experience, commercial priorities and lifecycle communications. 2. Journey Activation & Channel Governance
• Lead automated journey orchestration primarily across owned CRM channels
• Establish governance for segmentation, personalization and campaign standards.
• Coordinate with other channel owners (e.g., Media, Social, Digital) to ensure journey consistency.
• Drive structured adoption of personalization and audience activation tools. 3. Platform Business Ownership
• Act as business product owner of marketing automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud).
• Define functional requirements, prioritization and business roadmap.
• Partner with IT, as technical owner, for architecture, integrations, security and scalability.
• Ensure operational excellence of automations, data flows and activation processes. 4. Data Governance & Compliance
• Define lifecycle communication standards in alignment with Legal and IT.
• Ensure consent management and subscription governance frameworks are operationalized within marketing automation tools.
• Support privacy-by-design principles across activation use cases. 5. Commercial Impact & Performance
• Define CRM contribution metrics and dashboards.
• Monitor engagement, retention and revenue influence.
• Provide optimization roadmaps to senior leadership. 6. Lead the development of a customer insights framework, leveraging CRM data, external ad hoc research to inform brand health evolution. Translate customer understanding into actionable growth opportunities. Partner with Guest Experience teams, Marketing and Commercial teams to design and prioritize customer research initiatives, including satisfaction tracking, journey analysis, loyalty drivers, brand tracking,etc. 7. Team & Capability Building
• Build a high-performing marketing CRM team.
• Elevate internal understanding of marketing automation capabilities and limitations.
• Drive adoption and maturity of audience strategy and segmentation practices. Your Journey so far
• 15+ years of experience in CRM, customer lifecycle management, marketing automation or customer data roles, ideally in global and local environments.
• Proven experience driving customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty and retention through CRM at scale.
• Proven experience designing and managing complex customer journeys across multiple channels, markets and touchpoints, including long consideration and purchase cycles
• Deep understanding of CRM platforms, marketing automation tools and data-driven marketing,
• Solid knowledge on global standards for data capture, consent management, governance, and enrichment
• Strong analytical mindset with experience translating CRM data into actionable insights. Experience leading customer insights initiatives such as segmentation studies, loyalty drivers, NPS/satisfaction research or journey diagnostics.
• Proven people manager, able to build, structure and develop teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.
• Strong track record of working hands-on while leading strategically, especially in complex or fast-growth environments.
• Experience managing agencies and external partners.
• Prior experience in luxury, premium or high-end consumer brands strongly preferred as well as Travel & hospitality Your Essentials
• Strategic, customer-centric and commercially minded leader.
• Highly analytical, data-driven and comfortable translating insights into action.
• Technically savvy, with the ability to bridge business, data and technology teams.
• Structured, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
• Outstanding collaboration and influencing skills, with proven ability to operate in a matrix organization. At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony. We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea. Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.
